subject: recordTable format does not match camOp matrix

messages.author: 5fe4c5b9b1f81586
messages.subject: recordTable format does not match camOp matrix
parts:
Hello,

I have videos from 40 camera traps, each was deployed 4 times. I want to get the data ready for occupancy analysis. For the moment I will start with a single species analysis.

From what I understood I need to obtain a detection history matrix and to do that I need a record table and a camera operation matrix. 
I managed to construct an operation matrix with the cameraOperation function, in which I had to specify the "station" (in my case it's the camera, since there is only one per station) and the "sessions" (or deployments). In the matrix I obtain the rows were written in the format e.g. T004Cam1__Sess_1. 
The problem is I have a record table that I constructed myself. I have previously annotated the videos and have columns: camera, deployment, species, DateTime.

When I try to use the detectionHistory function it doesn't work. I am thinking there are errors in the structure of my record table, how is this supposed to look like? 
Is changing the names of the cameras (matching them to the ones of the cam operation matrix) going to fix this problem? 

Thank you very much

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] recordTable format does not match camOp matrix
parts:
Hello Nadia,
You can use a manually created record table. All you need is the station, species and date/time column.

Run 
data(recordTableSampleMultiSeason)
for an example.

And yes, the names of the stations must match exactly row names in the camera operation matrix.

To get a better idea if the workflow follow the examples in th vignette (not exactly you scenario but close enough) and examine the objects involved.

Also, in general it helps if you show the code and the error messges you got. Then I can answer more specifically.

Best regards,
Jürgen
